Rules.InvariantScript:
"data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
  "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 640 640'><polyline fill='none' stroke='#7CE38B' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' points='" &
  Concat(
    Sequence(ctxHypN),
    With(
      {
        t: 2 * Pi() * sldHypSmall.Value * Value / 600,
        q: (sldHypBig.Value - sldHypSmall.Value) / sldHypSmall.Value,
        s: 290 / (sldHypBig.Value - sldHypSmall.Value + sldHypDist.Value)
      },
      Text(320 + s * ((sldHypBig.Value - sldHypSmall.Value) * Cos(t) + sldHypDist.Value * Cos(q * t)), "0.0") & "," &
      Text(320 + s * ((sldHypBig.Value - sldHypSmall.Value) * Sin(t) - sldHypDist.Value * Sin(q * t)), "0.0")
    ),
    " "
  ) &
  "'/></svg>"
)
